description: 1936 is the Year of the Fire Rat in the Chinese zodiac, from January 24, 1936 to February 10, 1937. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1936 is the Year of the Fire Rat, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 24, 1936 and ended on February 10, 1937, so people born in 1936 before Jan 24 belong to the Wood Pig year.

sections.heading: When the 1936 Fire Rat year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1936 Fire Rat year began at Lunar New Year on January 24, 1936 and lasted until February 10, 1937, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 24 1936 therefore belongs to the Wood Pig year that started in 1935, while someone born in early 1937, up to Feb 10, is still a Fire Rat. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Fire Rat combination also falls in 1996, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1936 fell on a Friday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Fire Rat personality
paragraphs: Fire Rat years are associated with energetic, outspoken and adventurous people. The Rat's Water checks Fire in the controlling cycle, so the classic picture is a cool head paired with a hot temperament. People born then are often vivid, charming and quick to act. The usual caution is restlessness and sharp words, which a short pause before responding tends to soften.

Fire is the element of summer and full daylight, and a Fire year is traditionally said to turn up the volume of whatever animal it meets. Descriptions link it with passion, charisma, courage and a love of movement and expression. Fire-year people are often portrayed as lively, persuasive and quick to act, able to warm a room and rally others behind an idea. The element is associated with the heart and with joy, which gives it real generosity of spirit. Its traditional shadow is impatience: Fire can burn hot and fast, leading to restlessness, sharp words in the moment and a tendency to lose interest once the excitement fades.

sections.heading: 1936 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 1936 add up to 19, which reduces to 1. In the twelve-year cycle the Rat is the first animal, earthly branch Zi, with Water as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Fire, and in the five-element cycles water controls Fire. The year before was the Wood Pig and the year after is the Fire Ox.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Bing-Zi: Bing is the Fire heavenly stem and Zi is the Rat's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1936?
faq.answer: 1936 is the Year of the Fire Rat. It started on January 24, 1936 and ended on February 10, 1937.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1936?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 24. Born before January 24, 1936, you are a Wood Pig; born on or after it, you are a Fire Rat.

faq.question: What element is 1936 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Rat's own fixed element is Water; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1936?
faq.answer: Bing-Zi. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Rat year?
faq.answer: 1996, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1996.
